chunks: So he watered (their flock), then turned to the shade and said: 'My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send me.'

key_terms.لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ: For what You have sent down

ai.seo_question: What was the supplication of Prophet Musa (AS) when he sought refuge in the shade?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Musa’s retreat to the shade signifies a moment of humble reliance (tawakkul) after his initial act of service, illustrating the transition from human effort to divine provision. This supplication is viewed as the catalyst for his eventual marriage to Shu'ayb’s daughter and his preparation for prophethood, emphasizing that true success stems from recognizing one's poverty before Allah. The narrative underscores the virtue of modesty and the immediate responsiveness of God to the sincere pleas of the righteous.
